problem: Read an integer N (1 <= N <= 1000), followed by N signed 32-bit integers. Accumulate their sum in a signed 64-bit integer, divide using floating-point arithmetic, and print the arithmetic mean with exactly two digits after the decimal point followed by a newline.

problem_contract.description: Compute the arithmetic mean without truncating fractional results. Use a floating-point division after accumulating safely.
problem_contract.input_range: 1 <= N <= 1000; each value fits in signed 32-bit integer
problem_contract.output_rule: Print the arithmetic mean with exactly two digits after the decimal point.

expected_output_verification.comparison: trimmed exact text with normalized line endings
